card.name: Web credits and site-link endings
card.fires_on: Marks the end of a website name such as .com, or words in credit and 'for more info' lines near a link, in scraped web pages. It also fires on odd spots inside obfuscated or split names.

modes.label: Site name in credit line
modes.description: The .com part of a site name in a copyright or 'content provided by' line.

modes.label: More-info link lead-in
modes.description: Words in an author bio just before a web link.

modes.label: Odd mid-name spots
modes.description: Partway through an unusual or split word or symbol string.
modes.example: "Web Application Obfuscation: '-/WAFs.. Evasion.. Filters//alert(/<<Ob>>fuscation/)-'" by Mario He

card.writes: It pushes toward web-address and source-credit words like www and 'reproduced from' (including Chinese credit phrases).
card.plain: It spots the credit or website-link part at the end of a scraped web article.
